structural_success: Reason codes from the closed catalog only
Valid evidence handles from the authorized set
semantic_success: Supported p4 propositions are not wrongly rejected
The reservation targets the disputed span
The reason code matches the real problem (NEW_IMPLICATION or UNCERTAINTY_STRENGTHENED, or an acceptable catalog neighbor)
The global verdict blocks production acceptance
partial: Technically usable JSON with mixed semantic result: implication detected but a significant supported clause is also rejected, or the implication is flagged with the wrong span, or a catalog code is used that does not describe the actual error. A blocking global verdict alone is not semantic success.
failure: Significant false rejection of supported paraphrase
